 X News   Mizoram Mizoram cabinet hikes DA to 50%, approves regularisation of long-serving contractual staff Mizoram cabinet hikes DA to 50%, approves regularisation of long-serving contractual staff
 The Mizoram cabinet raised employee DA and approved regularisation for long-serving contractual and provisional staff. The decisions also cover MIFCO, schools, departmental posts, MBBS bond obligations and rice procurement.

 Story highlights The government withdrew its earlier proposal to privatise MIFCO Limited
 Fresh prerequisite conditions were approved for provincialisation of schools across Mizoram
 District Fisheries Development Officers will move from Level 10A to Level 11
 The Mizoram government on November 17 announced a four percentage-point hike in Dearness Allowance (DA) for state employees, raising it from 46 per cent to 50 per cent with effect from December 1.
 The decision was taken at a cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister Lalduhoma in Aizawl, an official said.
 The cabinet also approved doubling the DA for contractual employees from 10 per cent to 20 per cent, effective December 1.
 In another major decision, the cabinet approved the regularisation of contractual employees who have completed more than 10 years of service and provisional employees who have served for over 14 years.
 The meeting also decided to withdraw an earlier proposal to privatise the Mizoram Food and Allied Industries Corporation (MIFCO) Ltd and approved fresh prerequisite conditions for the provincialisation of schools.
 The cabinet further cleared the upgradation of the pay level of District Fisheries Development Officers from Level 10A to Level 11 and the restructuring of posts under the Directorate of Commerce and Industries.
 Other decisions included draft guidelines for engaging provisional employees, a scheme to engage state-sponsored MBBS graduates to fulfil their bond obligations and the draft Mizoram Local Rice Procurement Policy, 2026.
